editability_proof.executed: on the phase-12 scene in ?edit=1 mode (headless Chrome, private port)
editability_proof.steps: clicked L8 word 9 ("layer") -> the inspector opened with the word's decision record; set vertical offset +140 px and saved -> overlay {"L8:8":{"dt":0,"dy":140,"sc":1}} written; the frame at the same instant changed by 58,041 pixels; after reload the edit persisted in playback; after clearing the overlay and reloading, the frame was pixel-identical to the pristine frame (0 changed pixels)
editability_proof.verdict: the scene is an editable file system: a word-level change is made in the scene's own surface, persists, changes the picture, and strips back losslessly
